{"name":"claude/nice-dijkstra-208xq0","commit":{"sha":"c03ca90f19a9e64ba7751c069325a48b54b39c2e","node_id":"C_kwDOT8tB0doAKGMwM2NhOTBmMTlhOWU2NGJhNzc1MWMwNjkzMjVhNDhiNTRiMzljMmU","commit":{"author":{"name":"cosmosapjw-quantum","email":"cosmosapjw@gmail.com","date":"2026-10-19T18:14:10Z"},"committer":{"name":"cosmosapjw-quantum","email":"cosmosapjw@gmail.com","date":"2026-10-19T18:14:10Z"},"message":"research(triage): Amendment 8, tighten amended decision rules after review

An independent decision-gate review of Amendments 4-7 found that
Amendments 6 and 7 changed label-deciding rules, not only instruments,
and returned GO-WITH-CHANGES. This commit resolves its blocking items:

- B1: declare Amendments 6-7 as decision-rule amendments, align rule
  texts with the code, and preregister a sensitivity table against the
  e49b753 engine (frozen prereg + Amendments 1-5).
- B2: allocation gate is exact zero (identical warm allocations over
  >= 2 distinct attempt counts); per_attempt_max = 0.
- B3: missing allocation evidence is provisional (ALLOCATION_MISSING),
  never OPTIMIZE_ALLOCATION; constant-attempt cells are reported.
- B4: no-orphan rule for C1/C2 exoneration.
- B5: a rival is narrow only by its own components' coverage in their
  own universe.
- B6: SPECIALIZE_APPLICABILITY needs >= min_positives win cells,
  otherwise provisional (INSUFFICIENT_POSITIVES).
- A refused state sidecar gives null accuracy, not the inline fallback;
  RUNBOOK stop rule sidecars_refused == 0 and runner_inline == 0.

Smoke re-decision: only drv.fast_small changes (SPECIALIZE ->
provisional). Committed smoke outputs are kept as b56bb19 records.
Re-review of this diff: all items resolved, main campaign GO.
